title: docs(cloudinary): Use https cloudinary link to avoid mixed-content
body:
Here is what I currently see online:
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/26737293/be73c69e-47c9-11e7-894f-2e8352704dab.png)

This is because we load the React logo through Cloudinary on an `http` request while the website is in `https`:
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/26737309/d6123538-47c9-11e7-928b-deae031b2716.png)

Simple fix, but better result:
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/26737323/dffbc686-47c9-11e7-8481-1d96828bae0a.png)
